records.student_text: A motion description says, “The backpack remains beside Zoe on the seat while trees move backward past the window.” Identify the reference frame used when the backpack is described as remaining beside Zoe, and cite the cue.
records.student_html:
A motion description says, “The backpack remains beside Zoe on the seat while trees move backward past the window.” Identify the reference frame used when the backpack is described as remaining beside Zoe, and cite the cue.

  1. no reference frame is needed
  2. the vehicle/passenger frame
  3. the trees outside
  4. the backpack itself only
choices: no reference frame is needed
the vehicle/passenger frame
the trees outside
the backpack itself only
records.answer: The vehicle/passenger frame; the backpack stays at a fixed position relative to the passenger/seat.
